### How much horsepower and torque does a 2026 Honda Accord SE CVT have?

The 2026 Honda Accord SE CVT is equipped with a[n]Gasoline 1.5L I-4 engine that can produce up to 192 hp @ 6000 rpm horsepower and a maximum torque of 192 lb-ft @ 1700 rpm. The transmission is a[n] variable-Speed Automatic with front-wheel drive.

### How big is the 2026 Honda Accord SE CVT's fuel tank? How efficient is a 2026 Honda Accord SE CVT?

The 2026 Honda Accord SE CVT has a 56 L fuel tank and requires Unleaded. Natural Resources Canada estimates that the 2026 Honda Accord will use about 8.1 L/100 km when you drive in the city and 6.4 L/100 km for highway driving.

### What are the dimensions, weight, and seating capacity of the 2026 Honda Accord SE CVT?

The dimensions of the 2026 Honda Accord SE CVT are 4971 mm (195.7 in) in length, 1862 mm (73.3 in) in width, 1449 mm (57.0 in) in height.  
 It has an approximate weight of 1493 kg (3292 lbs) and seating for 2+3 seats in the front and rear seats.  
The Accord offers 473 L (16.7 ft³) of cargo space in the trunk.   
The Accord SE CVT wheels measure 19-inch in diameter. The size of the Spare Wheels is a Standard, Spacesaver size.

### What are the 2026 Honda Accord SE CVT safety ratings?

The 2026 Honda Accord SE CVT receives a 5.0 Overall rating from IIHS with specific 5 rating for side impact and 5 for frontal crash rating.

### What are the 2026 Honda Accord SE CVT safety features?

The 2026 Honda Accord SE CVT features total of 10 (Front, Side, Side Curtain, Knee) airbags and Standard anti-collision System, Standard lane departure warning, Standard hill holder and Standard low tire pressure monitor. Additional safety equipment includes LED, Complex Surface, Auto Highbeam headlights and Rear, Camera parking assistance.

### What sound system and display does the 2026 Honda Accord SE CVT have?

The 2026 Honda Accord SE CVT Vehicle is equipped with a 8-speaker audio system and features a 10.20-inch, Touchscreen display with voice-activating capabilities for . You can also connect your device to the audio system via Carplay, Android, USB, Bluetooth, AM/FM.

### Does the 2026 Honda Accord SE CVT have memory seats?

No, The 2026 Honda Accord SE CVT doesn't have memory seats. Memory seats adjust the seat settings quickly and easily to saved preferences without having to manually adjust. Additionally, this trim also comes with Heated and Cloth seats in front.
